# test-case and test-target detection in test files

Detects test cases (named test/it calls) in test files and records test targets that reference implementation modules. The test verifies node_ids for test cases in 'src/billing/rules.test.ts' and that a test target points at the implementation module 'src.billing.rules'.

**Anchored to:**

- `tests/test_typescript_analyzer.py` — `tests.test_typescript_analyzer.test_test_files_produce_cases_and_targets`
